text:
Maria Chen: quick check — i'm about to promote the staging overlay for svc-payments to prod. terraform plan looks OK but i want eyes on the configmap/rollout bits before i hit apply. plan: https://ci.internal/plan/abcd1234 :eyes:

Maria Chen: TL;DR changes:
- add configmap payments-config with metrics.enabled=true
- add sidecar prometheus exporter container to deployment if metrics.enabled
- add rollout strategy for canary via annotations and rollout-controller config

Maria Chen: snippet from the k8s patch i'm planning to apply:
```yaml
spec:
  template:
    metadata:
      annotations:
        rollout.example.com/canary: "true"
        rollout.example.com/canary-weights: "5,25,100"
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: payments
        image: registry/release/payments:2026-03-14
      - name: metrics-exporter
        image: registry/tools/prom-exporter:1.2
        envFrom:
        - configMapRef:
            name: payments-config
```

Aj Patel: Looks straightforward. question: where are the secret mounts for exporter creds coming from? we moved secret sources around last month.

Samir Gupta: exporter creds should be from aws-secretsmanager, path: /redwood/svc-payments/prom. tf change is in modules/secrets-manager/main.tf line ~48. i can paste plan snippet if helpful.

infra-bot: terraform plan completed for branch staging-promote (plan id: abcd1234). Summary: 3 to add, 1 to change, 0 to destroy. Detailed plan: https://ci.internal/plan/abcd1234#diff

Leo Kim: @Maria two gating questions:
- do we want 5% for 30m, then 25% for 1h, then 100%?
- do we need a fallback variant (no-exporter) for quick rollback if metrics cause issues?

Maria Chen: yes to gating. i'd like automated rollback on errors and a manual button for instant cutoff. fallback variant sounds good — i'll add a rollout annotation to point at the previous stable image as fallback.

Ops Oncall: also double-check service account IAM: metrics exporter needs ssm:GetParameters? or secretsmanager:GetSecretValue? make sure we don't expand privileges.

Samir Gupta: exporter only needs secretsmanager:GetSecretValue on that one ARN. tf diff shows the policy narrowed to that resource. copy/paste from plan:
```hcl
+ resource "aws_iam_policy" "svc_payments_metrics" {
+   name = "svc-payments-metrics"
+   policy = jsonencode({
+     Statement = [{ Action = ["secretsmanager:GetSecretValue"], Resource = "arn:aws:secretsmanager:...:secret:redwood/svc-payments/prom-*" }]
+   })
+}
```

Aj Patel: LGTM from me if Samir confirms the policy mapping. can someone run the tf apply in staging, then i'll run the promote job to prod if no alerts after 40m? :+1:

Maria Chen: i'll deploy to staging now. staging apply kicked off: https://ci.internal/apply/efgh5678

infra-bot: apply finished for staging (efgh5678). health checks passed, no 5xx, cpu stable.

Ops Oncall: i'll monitor metrics for the next 40m and keep the oncall channel updated. if we see any exporter spikes we pause rollout and rollback to previous variant.

Leo Kim: small nit — add a README note in overlays/staging/svc-payments/README.md about the canary weights and the manual rollback steps. saves time during incidents.

Maria Chen: good call, will add it after prod promote. planning prod promote at 1967890600 unless anyone objects.

Samir Gupta: no objections. :shipit:

Aj Patel: :+1:

infra-bot: prod promote job queued by Maria Chen at 1967890600. job: https://ci.internal/promote/ijkl9012

Maria Chen: thanks all — i'll post updates in this thread with final timestamps.

infra-bot: prod promote started (ijkl9012).

infra-bot: prod promote succeeded. rollout at 5% -> 25% -> 100% completed, no automated rollback triggered. logs: https://ci.internal/promote/ijkl9012/logs

Maria Chen: verified dashboards look stable. closing this thread. :tada:
